item.title: Martin County School District to cut 16 administrative positions, save nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut district staff as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year, saving nearly $4 million from next year's budget.

item.title: St. Lucie pancreatic cancer patient Russell Reed approved for experimental drug after 62-day wait
item.description: A St. Lucie man battling pancreatic cancer is sharing his story after finally gaining access to an experimental treatment his family hopes will give him more time.

item.title: Fort Pierce Commissioner Broderick says city lacks real estate management for waterfront properties
item.description: Fort Pierce Commissioner Michael Broderick acknowledged the city's handling of city-owned real estate that is leased out to tenants is not being managed, following ongoing disputes over waterfront properties.

item.title: Hobe Sound gets first Aldi grocery store opening Wednesday at former Winn-Dixie site
item.description: Hobe Sound is getting its first Aldi store when the new grocery store opens Wednesday at 8867 SE Bridge Road in the space where Winn-Dixie used to be.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner says $9,000 insurance bill may force her to sell home
item.description: Kelly Hagen says her homeowners insurance has jumped from $6,000 to $9,000 a year, adding $750 a month to her mortgage payment and forcing her to work two jobs.

item.title: Martin County School District plans to cut 16 administrative positions, save $3.9 million
item.description: Superintendent Michael Maine said the plan includes eliminating 16 administrative and district-level positions, including three assistant principal positions, and removing 42 unfilled instructional vacancies.

item.description: The United States was eliminated from the World Cup on Monday after Belgium defeated the Americans 4-1 at Lumen Field in Seattle in the round of 16. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina beats Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time to advance in World Cup
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 on Friday and advanced to the World Cup Round of 16 in a thrilling match in which the tiny island nation challenged the reigning champion until the final minutes of extra time.

item.title: Treasure Coast Seafood Festival Returns to Vero Beach in November for 18th Year
item.description: Under The Sun Promotions, Inc announced the 18th Annual Treasure Coast Seafood Festival will return to Vero Beach this November.

item.title: DeSantis closes final bill-signing season after signing more than 2,000 Florida laws
item.description: Ron DeSantis has likely wrapped his final regular bill-signing season, closing one of his last major opportunities to shape Florida law from the governor's desk. item.title: Florida median-income households need 17 months longer to save for home down payment than a decade ago
item.description: A new study by Smart Asset finds it now takes the median-income household earner in Florida 17 months longer to save up for a down payment in 2026 than in 2016.

item.title: Vision Marine Technologies plans sale of Palm City property
item.description: Vision Marine Technologies has announced plans to sell its Palm City property after consolidating operations.

item.title: Construction begins on 18-hole golf course at Esplanade at Solaeris in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Work has started on a Wilczynski-designed 18-hole golf course at Taylor Morrison's new golf residential community in Port St. Lucie.

item.title: Stand Insurance launches AI-driven contractor matching for Florida homeowners
item.description: New insurance company Stand Insurance is using AI technology to help Florida homeowners connect with affordable contractors for required home improvements.

item.title: My Safe Florida Home grant delays leave homeowners unable to afford required upgrades
item.description: Vero Beach homeowner Kelly Hagen was turned away for a $10,000 My Safe Florida Home grant after it took too long to find a contractor.
